result.markdown:
For most small support teams, **Freshdesk is my top recommendation**\. It offers a good balance of affordability, ticket management, automation, reporting and room to grow without the complexity of an enterprise platform.

However, the best choice depends on how your team handles customer enquiries.

(Best overall)

From \$19/agent/month, annual billing

- Excellent ticket management and automation.
- Shared inbox, knowledge base and reporting.
- Good balance of features and cost.
- Suitable for growing support teams.
